tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetches the full content of one published article on denisetiawan.me by its slug. Use this after search_articles or list_recent_articles when the visitor wants to read or discuss a specific article's full text, not just its title/excerpt.

tools.name: get_author_profile
tools.description: Fetch the author bio, social media profiles, and core topic areas (params: none) -> {name, bio, social_links: [{platform, url}], topics: [{category, title, description, url}]}

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Fetch the full content and metadata of a specific blog post (params: id, slug, url, navigate=false) -> {id, title, url, author, date_published, category, headings, content}

id.description: Post ID, slug or URL path (e.g. 'why-i-use-n8n-for-automation')

navigate.description: Whether to navigate to the post page in the browser

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: Fetch a list of published blog posts, optionally filtered by category (params: category) -> {category, count, posts: [{id, title, url, category, excerpt}]}

category.description: Optional category filter: ai, 3d-printing, coding, automation, gadget, tutorial

tools.name: list_recent_articles
tools.description: Lists the most recently published articles on denisetiawan.me, newest first. Use this when the visitor asks what's new or wants a general reading list.

limit.description: Number of articles to return (default 5, max 20).

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Searches published article titles and summaries on denisetiawan.me. Returns titles, slugs, excerpts, and publish dates for matching posts. Note: this matches titles and summaries only, not full article body text (the body is rich text and isn't substring-searchable). Use this when the visitor asks to find content about a topic.

query.description: Search terms (keywords, topic, or title fragment).

limit.description: Max number of results to return (default 5, max 20).

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search blog posts by keyword or topic (params: query, navigate=true) -> navigates to search results page; navigate=false returns {query, total_results, results: [{id, title, url, category, excerpt}]}

query.description: Keyword or topic to search for

navigate.description: Whether to navigate to the search page in the browser (default true)
